title: 5-Hour Private Customized Luxury Convertible Tour of Oahu's South Shore
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Collapsible wheelchairs with removable wheels can be accommodated
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Price is for car and driver NOT per person. The car can carry 4 passengers plus a driver so the more passengers the better the deal. Enjoy a 5-hour tour of Oahu's south shore beaches in a customized four-door luxury convertible. Great for individuals, couples, or a family of four. Dark red Chrysler 300C convertible is the only four-door convertible on the island with plenty of leg room for everyone. Tours are flexible and routes customized according to customers schedule and interest. Book for 1 traveler which means 1 vehicle. If you select 2, 3, or 4 the booking system doesn't understand and will tell you it's unavailable.
